uncertainties: Secret reveal ordering, automatic-cast completion, battlefield-copy and repeat windows follow existing local public contracts and are not current CN calibration.

Star Power uses five decreasing printed base hits, with current Spell Damage applied to each actual hit; this exact Spell Damage/repetition edge is a recorded local interpretation without a decisive official runtime trace.

Malfunction chooses one 3 or 6 base split budget at its payload window; ordinary Spell Damage is added once by the existing split executor. The full primary text establishes the conditional extra damage, not every multiplier/timing edge.

Echo/Potion capture original live friendly minion references in board order, then copy each surviving original residence through the existing current-copy executor; later reaction-window departures are not rebound.
